notes.title: Update 1.4.2 | Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Sticky Struggles keeps on getting better! We've listened to your feedback and put it into practice in this latest version.[/b]

- Arrow keys no longer trigger the wait condition on guide playback pages when an attempt is made to show pages that do not exist. This fix improves the user experience by preventing unnecessary delays during navigation;
- The undo action hotkey has been changed from 'U' to 'Z'. This update aligns with common user expectations and standard practices in many applications, providing a more intuitive and user-friendly experience.

If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, [url=https://pactiongames.com/#contact]please reach out to us.[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.3.3 | Patch
Update 1.3.2 | Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Sticky Struggles keeps on getting better! We've listened to your feedback and put it into practice in this latest version.[/b]

- In addition to obtaining the achievement 'Better Than Before' when setting a new record for a previously completed level, it is now automatically granted to players when all objectives in all levels have been completed. This change was made to address an issue where players who had completed all objectives in every level on their first attempt were unable to obtain the achievement due to the inability to set a new personal best on any level.
- The number of levels displayed per row on the level selection screen will now dynamically adjust based on the aspect ratio in which the game is played.
- Fixed a bug where specific elements on level selection screen failed to scale appropriately if resolution was changed;
- Minor optimisations and improvements.

If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, [url=https://pactiongames.com/#contact]please reach out to us.[/url]
